usageNote: 动词短语！spend + 时间 + doing，超常用搭配，聊梦想计划时必备，听起来很潇洒✈️

examples.en: She decided to spend a year travelling across Southeast Asia after graduation.
examples.zh: 她决定毕业后花一年时间游遍东南亚。

examples.en: He spent a year travelling alone and came back a totally different person.
examples.zh: 他独自旅行了一年，回来后整个人都变了。
